subject: How to reduce the font size of tick marks and rotate them?

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: How to reduce the font size of tick marks and rotate them?
parts:
Hi,

The tick marks on some of my plots are not small enough. They overlap
each other. I don't see how to reduce the font size of tick marks and
rotate them. It seems that they usually should not be manually tuned.
But could you please let me how to tune them for this case? (BTW, I
use ggfluctuation)

--
Regards,
Peng

messages.subject: Re: How to reduce the font size of tick marks and rotate them?
parts:
Hi,

For example, I want to rotate the label 'hwy' from vertical to
horizontal orientation and to rotate 'displ' from horizontal to
vertical orientation? I also want to rotate the number 2, 3, ... 7 at
the x-axis by 90 degree (either clock or counterclockwise).

library(ggplot2)
head(mpg)
png('main.png')
qplot(displ,hwy,data=mpg)
dev.off()

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: How to reduce the font size of tick marks and rotate them?
parts:
g <- ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy))
g + geom_point() + opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(angle = 90),
                         axis.title.x = theme_text(angle = 90),
                         axis.title.y = theme_text(angle = 0))

HTH,
Dennis

messages.author: 5196f936ff792c35
messages.subject: Re: How to reduce the font size of tick marks and rotate them?
parts: Just use the + opts() like you do in ggplot().

library(ggplot2)
head(mpg)
png('main.png')

qplot(displ,hwy,data=mpg) + opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(angle = 90), axis.title.x = theme_text(angle = 90), axis.title.y = theme_text(angle = 0))
dev.off()

Works like a charm. 

Brandon
